clips.title: The story
paras: A member of the Twilight's Hammer asks you to find Theldurin the Lost, who was once of their order, lost his mind, and fled with the scroll of Myzrael. Rumor places him in the Badlands.

Theldurin once belonged to the Twilight's Hammer, until his mind slipped and he turned his back on the order's teachings. As he fled, he took the scroll of Myzrael with him. Those he left behind could not catch him.
The order has heard that Theldurin hides in the Badlands, raving and mad. The scroll is needed for the Lady's return, and to get it you must first find the man who took it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Theldurin the Lost was once a member of our order, the Twilight's Hammer. But he lost his mind and scorned our teachings. And before he fled from us, he stole the scroll of Myzrael! We could not catch him, but rumors say he hides in the Badlands, gibbering and mad.
To bring the Lady back to us, you must find the scroll. And to do that, you must find Theldurin.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello. Hello, hello hello hello hello HELLO!
I'm sorry - wait, no I'm not! Don't be rude!
But...sometimes being crazy is my only solace.
